episodes.title: Priests answer the question they dread most | You Can’t Ask That | Full Episode
episodes.description:
Is being a priest an outdated career choice? Catholic and Anglican priests answer the anonymous questions you’ve always wanted to ask, from celibacy, sexuality and how priests party, to the abuse crisis, doubt and the moments that stay with them. #YouCantAskThat

You Can't Ask That — Stream all seasons on ABC iview: https://ab.co/CantAskThat
___________________________________________

TV Series You Can't Ask That asks outrageous, uncomfortable and shocking questions to uncover the truth behind some of the most marginalised and misunderstood Australians.

Stream full episodes on our YouTube channel, Sundays 12pm. 

Chaptering:  
0:00 Introduction - Priests  
0:45 Why become a priest?  
3:29 Do you have a sex life?  
6:43 Do you believe gay people are going to hell?  
9:50 Burning bushes, water into wine, resurrection: how much do you actually buy?  
12:38 Why are so many priests paedophiles?  
16:38 How can you preach right and wrong when your church has hurt so many people?  
20:15 How do priests party?  
23:33 Have you ever doubted your belief?  
25:24 What have you witnessed that sticks with you? 
28:18 Guest names
